claims.text: The driver cannot carry POL-NS-01 limb (c). For a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup the minimum continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 seconds, and the clause measures it from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap. The derived arrival facts record a single qualifying hold of 236 seconds (25 fixes, first 07:44:14, last 07:48:10) - 64 seconds short of the minimum. Limbs (a) to (d) are conjunctive, so limb (c) alone defeats the charge: the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 and the reversal the driver has filed against must stand.

POL-NS-06 disposes of the shortfall on its own terms. The required minimum for TRANSPORT_HUB is 300 seconds and the effective in-geofence dwell on this trace is 236 seconds, a shortfall of 64 seconds. On those figures the clause is unambiguous: the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages, and where the cumulative dwell still falls short the full refund stands with no driver compensation payable. The artifact carrying that fact, the GPS trace, is COMPLETE at weight 1.0.

The driver's 10.1-minute wait_time_min is measured from the 07:38:05 'arrived' marker, and the policy does not accept that marker as the start of anything. The derived arrival data places the first qualifying in-geofence fix 369 seconds after the marker, at 07:44:14, so the driver was not holding inside the 150 m hub arrival radius when the marker was set; the driver track over that same interval shows travel speeds up to 47.6 kph and a track distance reaching 2,749.6 m. The rider's account that she found no vehicle at the bay at about 07:43 is consistent with a trace whose first in-radius fix is 07:44:14. Whether the marker is treated as false under POL-NS-05, or simply as not starting the clock under POL-NS-01(c), the dwell that counts is 236 seconds.

The driver has no route to accumulate the missing seconds under POL-NS-06(i). That limb sums separate in-geofence intervals only where the trace shows the driver leaving and re-entering, and it is expressly conditioned on a traffic_advisory that is present and populated. The trace shows a single interval - run_count 1, accumulated dwell 236 seconds, identical to the longest run - so there is no second interval to add. The advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and carries no payload, which makes limb (i) unavailable outright; I rely on that absence itself, which is citable, and I do not assert an advisory that does not exist.

No compensation is payable to the driver on this fee. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the cancellation fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Here POL-NS-06 displaces it and says in terms that no driver compensation is payable, so the SGD 6.00 line itemised in the fare breakdown cannot be restored to the driver, and the driver's 3 no-show terminations in 30 days against 88 completed trips neither creates nor defeats an entitlement that the failing dwell limb has already removed.

The fare record fixes the money and leaves nothing for the driver to reclaim. The fare breakdown itemises a SGD 6.00 cancellation fee, shows payment_status REFUNDED and refund_issued_sgd 6.00. SGD 6.00 is exactly what fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for this trip - the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee of 6.00 exceeds the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of 4.00, so the greater fee governs - and there is therefore no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect to disturb the reversal. On a dispute filed by the driver, POL-GEN-03 makes the present state the rider-protective one: NO_ACTION leaves the refund in place, while FULL_REFUND would return the whole contested amount to the filing driver on a claim the dwell arithmetic has already defeated.

The rider was not the problem, and the record says so. Her own track is unbroken and stationary at the pickup: 88 fixes, every one of them qualifying, running 50.5 m to 91.7 m from the pickup pin - comfortably inside the 200 m hub presence radius set in the fee schedule - from 07:43:10 through and past the whole of the driver's 236-second hold. Because POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present, rider conduct cannot rescue a charge that the dwell arithmetic has already failed.

Disclosure, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires: the chat log EV-CHAT-00209 is IMPAIRED at weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE - both driver messages and the system arrival notification carry read_at null. I use it only for that fact and for the rider's account that she saw nothing until afterwards. It does not carry the deciding fact: the 236-second dwell comes from EV-GPS-00209 and EV-TRIP-00209, both COMPLETE at 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence this ruling may take is 1.0, not 0.85. The UNREAD_MESSAGE tag is a schema-level tag and does not meet the limbs (a) to (d) defects POL-NS-08 defines - three messages against a chat_message_count of 3, a complete msg_id sequence, and a single five-minute-plus gap running from 07:38:40 to 07:44:20 that does not span the arrival marker at 07:38:05 - so it down-weights confidence only and does not engage POL-NS-08's escalation sentence.

No escalation trigger is engaged, so this dispute should be decided rather than sent upstairs with the money in limbo. The deciding artifacts sit at weight 1.0 and so clear the platform confidence floor in POL-NS-09(a); POL-NS-09(c) turns on the counterparty-dispute counters, which are zero on both sides (rider 0, driver 0); and POL-NS-09(d) is not reached on the rider's side either, because rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The bundle here is complete, internally consistent and resolves on one arithmetic fact - the 64-second dwell shortfall - which is a finding for the rider, not an open question for a reviewer.

claims.text: The platform's own telemetry puts the driver at the pickup point, not merely in the vicinity: the trace holds 25 consecutive fixes inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius recorded in trip_record.pickup_zone_class, far more than the 3 consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, and that run ends at the cancellation timestamp itself. POL-NS-02 is therefore satisfied and, on that clause's own words, the dispute turns on dwell duration under POL-NS-01 limb (c). Limbs (a) and (d) of POL-NS-01 are also met: there is an 'arrived' event at 07:38:05 and the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, not DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The record cannot support the rider's suggestion that no car ever came to the bay.

The driver does not dispute the number that defeats the fee, and puts it on the record rather than leaving it to be discovered: the policy-measured dwell is 236 seconds, running from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:44:14 to the cancellation at 07:48:10, which is 64 seconds short of the 300 second minimum for TRANSPORT_HUB, because POL-NS-01(c) runs the clock from that first in-geofence fix and not from the 07:38:05 marker. The recorded wait_time_min of 10.1 is real but is measured from the marker, so the driver does not ask the Judge to charge the fee on the strength of it.

No false-arrival referral can be entered against this driver. POL-NS-05(ii) fires only where the trip contains no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere, and this trace carries 25 of them in one continuous run, so whatever view the Judge takes of the 07:38:05 marker under POL-NS-05, the referral limb is unreachable on this record and the driver's record stays clean.

The rider cannot reach POL-NS-04, so no rider-side exoneration and no rider-side elimination of coordination fault can be built on it: limb (a) fails at the threshold because not one message in the waiting window is hers — the log holds only the platform's 07:38:06 arrival notice and the driver's two attempts to coordinate. EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (both driver messages and the system notice carry read_at null); that impairment goes only to receipts and not to authorship, so the finding that the rider sent nothing survives the discount, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty so the voice-call route is closed to her as well.

The rider's account that there was no car to be found speaks only to the first minute of the window, not to the last four: from 07:44:14 until the cancellation at 07:48:10 the driver's device was inside the 150 m arrival radius, while the rider's own device was between 50 and 92 metres from the same recorded pickup pin (venue VEN-TAMPINES-INTERCHANGE) across all 88 of her qualifying fixes. For the whole of that 236 second run both devices were inside the hub radii of one recorded pin, so what failed was coordination, not the driver's presence.

The case is decidable and should not be held on an integrity theory. The 07:38:05 marker sits one second from a GPS fix at 07:38:04, far inside the 90 second POL-NS-08(a) allowance; the trace is unbroken at 10 second cadence with no gap of any length; and the SGD 6.00 fare line reconciles with the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00), so no POL-NS-08 limb (a) to (d) defect is present. The deciding dwell rests on weight-1.0 artifacts, so the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap is 1.0.

No abuse or escalation finding is open against the driver: his citable counters are 3 no-show terminations across 88 completed trips in 30 days, a rate of 3.4 percent, below both limbs of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check (4 or more terminations, and a rate above 8 percent), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 with disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 on both profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged. No profile field outside the ones POL-NS-07 and POL-NS-09 name — in particular not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter — may be used to build an adverse finding against him.

The driver makes no POL-NS-06(i) accumulation argument and asks the Judge to record that he does not: EV-ADVIS-00209-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so no traffic_advisory is present to permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, and in any event the trace shows a single in-geofence interval with no second interval to add. Advisory relief asserted against a missing artifact would be an abuse of the record and the driver declines it.

If the Judge reads the 369 seconds between the driver's 07:38:05 marker and his first in-geofence fix at 07:44:14 as a hold at the wrong face of the hub — which is the shape of the rider's own account, that she reached the interchange PHV bay at about 07:43 and found no car — then POL-NS-03 governs the driver's money. The trace over that interval is complete (100 percent coverage, no gap), the driver's own in-app message at 07:38:40 placed him at the interchange PHV bay, the trip record shows 2 registered pickup points at VEN-TAMPINES-INTERCHANGE, and neither party named a sub-location in the chat log (the rider sent nothing at all): on those facts POL-NS-03(ii) attributes the mislocation to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver receives the platform-funded 50 percent goodwill of SGD 3.00 that the fare breakdown already computes under POL-NS-03, independent of and never netted against the rider's full refund.

ruling.explanation: Both parties agree on the number that decides this case, and the record confirms it. The driver's 'arrived' tap at 07:38:05 does not start the waiting clock: POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the marker. On the GPS trace EV-GPS-00209 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) the driver held a single continuous position inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius for 236 seconds, from 07:44:14 to the cancellation at 07:48:10 — 64 seconds short of the 300-second minimum for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup. The trip record's 10.1-minute wait_time_min is real but is measured from the marker, and the policy does not accept that start. POL-NS-01 limb (c) therefore fails, and POL-NS-06 requires the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee to be refunded to the rider in full. Because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied, POL-NS-07 pays the driver nothing, and POL-NS-06 says in terms that no driver compensation is payable. The driver cannot recover the missing seconds under POL-NS-06(i): the trace shows one in-geofence interval (there is no second interval to add), and the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00209-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable — a point both sides put on the record, and which the referee struck from both cases only because the missing artifact's issue code was not named as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. The chat log EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE: both driver messages and the system notice carry read_at null); it does not carry the deciding dwell fact, which rests on weight-1.0 artifacts, so it does not cap confidence, and because the rider sent no message in the window POL-NS-04 is not available to her either. No POL-NS-08(a) to (d) defect is present: the marker sits one second from a GPS fix (well inside the 90-second allowance), the trace is unbroken at 10-second cadence, the chat holds three messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count with an intact msg_id sequence, and the SGD 6.00 fee reconciles with the governing greater figure (the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee of 6.00 over the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of 4.00). No escalation trigger is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the counterparty-dispute counters are zero on both profiles, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is not tripped (3 terminations against 88 completed trips, 3.4%), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. Outcome: the fee was not chargeable and the fare record already shows it reversed (payment_status REFUNDED, refund_issued_sgd 6.00). This dispute is filed by the driver seeking to undo that reversal, and the driver's claim is not supported. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION on a driver-filed dispute over an already-reversed fee leaves the rider refunded; it never restores the charge, so no money moves to the filing driver. No referral is entered: POL-NS-05(ii)'s false-arrival record requires a trip with no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere, and this trace carries 25 of them.

ruling.explanation:
The fee does not stand, but there is nothing left to pay out either: the platform reversed the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee on 31 July and the money is already back with the rider. Because this dispute was filed by the driver, the outcome under POL-GEN-03 is NO_ACTION — the driver's request to restore the fee is not supported by the evidence, and the present state (rider refunded) is left as it is. ledger.claim: The driver cannot carry POL-NS-01 limb (c). For a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup the minimum continuous in-geofence dwell is 300 seconds, and the clause measures it from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap. POL-NS-06 disposes of the shortfall on its own terms. The required minimum for TRANSPORT_HUB is 300 seconds and the effective in-geofence dwell on this trace is 236 seconds, a shortfall of 64 seconds. On those figures the clause is unambiguous: the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages, and where the cumulative dwell still falls short the full refund stands with no driver compensation payable. The artifact carrying that fact, the GPS trace, is COMPLETE at weight 1.0.

The driver's 10.1-minute wait_time_min is measured from the 07:38:05 'arrived' marker, and the policy does not accept that marker as the start of anything. The derived arrival data places the first qualifying in-geofence fix 369 seconds after the marker, at 07:44:14, so the driver was not holding inside the 150 m hub arrival radius when the marker was set; the driver track over that same interval shows travel speeds up to 47.6 kph and a track distance reaching 2,749.6 m. The rider's account that she found no vehicle at the bay at about 07:43 is consistent with a trace whose first in-radius fix is 07:44:14. Whether the marker is treated as false under POL-NS-05, or simply as not starting the clock under POL-NS-01(c), the dwell that counts is 236 seconds.

ledger.claim: No compensation is payable to the driver on this fee. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the cancellation fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Here POL-NS-06 displaces it and says in terms that no driver compensation is payable, so the SGD 6.00 line itemised in the fare breakdown cannot be restored to the driver, and the driver's 3 no-show terminations in 30 days against 88 completed trips neither creates nor defeats an entitlement that the failing dwell limb has already removed.

The fare record fixes the money and leaves nothing for the driver to reclaim. The fare breakdown itemises a SGD 6.00 cancellation fee, shows payment_status REFUNDED and refund_issued_sgd 6.00. SGD 6.00 is exactly what fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for this trip - the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee of 6.00 exceeds the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of 4.00, so the greater fee governs - and there is therefore no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect to disturb the reversal. On a dispute filed by the driver, POL-GEN-03 makes the present state the rider-protective one: NO_ACTION leaves the refund in place, while FULL_REFUND would return the whole contested amount to the filing driver on a claim the dwell arithmetic has already defeated.

The rider was not the problem, and the record says so. Her own track is unbroken and stationary at the pickup: 88 fixes, every one of them qualifying, running 50.5 m to 91.7 m from the pickup pin - comfortably inside the 200 m hub presence radius set in the fee schedule - from 07:43:10 through and past the whole of the driver's 236-second hold. Because POL-NS-06 refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present, rider conduct cannot rescue a charge that the dwell arithmetic has already failed.

Disclosure, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires: the chat log EV-CHAT-00209 is IMPAIRED at weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE - both driver messages and the system arrival notification carry read_at null. I use it only for that fact and for the rider's account that she saw nothing until afterwards. It does not carry the deciding fact: the 236-second dwell comes from EV-GPS-00209 and EV-TRIP-00209, both COMPLETE at 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence this ruling may take is 1.0, not 0.85. The UNREAD_MESSAGE tag is a schema-level tag and does not meet the limbs (a) to (d) defects POL-NS-08 defines - three messages against a chat_message_count of 3, a complete msg_id sequence, and a single five-minute-plus gap running from 07:38:40 to 07:44:20 that does not span the arrival marker at 07:38:05 - so it down-weights confidence only and does not engage POL-NS-08's escalation sentence.

No escalation trigger is engaged, so this dispute should be decided rather than sent upstairs with the money in limbo. The deciding artifacts sit at weight 1.0 and so clear the platform confidence floor in POL-NS-09(a); POL-NS-09(c) turns on the counterparty-dispute counters, which are zero on both sides (rider 0, driver 0); and POL-NS-09(d) is not reached on the rider's side either, because rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The bundle here is complete, internally consistent and resolves on one arithmetic fact - the 64-second dwell shortfall - which is a finding for the rider, not an open question for a reviewer.

The platform's own telemetry puts the driver at the pickup point, not merely in the vicinity: the trace holds 25 consecutive fixes inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius recorded in trip_record.pickup_zone_class, far more than the 3 consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, and that run ends at the cancellation timestamp itself. POL-NS-02 is therefore satisfied and, on that clause's own words, the dispute turns on dwell duration under POL-NS-01 limb (c). Limbs (a) and (d) of POL-NS-01 are also met: there is an 'arrived' event at 07:38:05 and the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, not DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. The record cannot support the rider's suggestion that no car ever came to the bay.

The driver does not dispute the number that defeats the fee, and puts it on the record rather than leaving it to be discovered: the policy-measured dwell is 236 seconds, running from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:44:14 to the cancellation at 07:48:10, which is 64 seconds short of the 300 second minimum for TRANSPORT_HUB, because POL-NS-01(c) runs the clock from that first in-geofence fix and not from the 07:38:05 marker. The recorded wait_time_min of 10.1 is real but is measured from the marker, so the driver does not ask the Judge to charge the fee on the strength of it.

No false-arrival referral can be entered against this driver. POL-NS-05(ii) fires only where the trip contains no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere, and this trace carries 25 of them in one continuous run, so whatever view the Judge takes of the 07:38:05 marker under POL-NS-05, the referral limb is unreachable on this record and the driver's record stays clean.

The rider cannot reach POL-NS-04, so no rider-side exoneration and no rider-side elimination of coordination fault can be built on it: limb (a) fails at the threshold because not one message in the waiting window is hers — the log holds only the platform's 07:38:06 arrival notice and the driver's two attempts to coordinate. EV-CHAT-00209 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue UNREAD_MESSAGE (both driver messages and the system notice carry read_at null); that impairment goes only to receipts and not to authorship, so the finding that the rider sent nothing survives the discount, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty so the voice-call route is closed to her as well.

The rider's account that there was no car to be found speaks only to the first minute of the window, not to the last four: from 07:44:14 until the cancellation at 07:48:10 the driver's device was inside the 150 m arrival radius, while the rider's own device was between 50 and 92 metres from the same recorded pickup pin (venue VEN-TAMPINES-INTERCHANGE) across all 88 of her qualifying fixes. For the whole of that 236 second run both devices were inside the hub radii of one recorded pin, so what failed was coordination, not the driver's presence.

The case is decidable and should not be held on an integrity theory. The 07:38:05 marker sits one second from a GPS fix at 07:38:04, far inside the 90 second POL-NS-08(a) allowance; the trace is unbroken at 10 second cadence with no gap of any length; and the SGD 6.00 fare line reconciles with the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00), so no POL-NS-08 limb (a) to (d) defect is present. The deciding dwell rests on weight-1.0 artifacts, so the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap is 1.0.

No abuse or escalation finding is open against the driver: his citable counters are 3 no-show terminations across 88 completed trips in 30 days, a rate of 3.4 percent, below both limbs of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check (4 or more terminations, and a rate above 8 percent), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 with disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 on both profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged.
